answer: Unique preimage answer gate. An agent submits a nonce making H(nonce || pubkey || task id) meet a target and yield a digest absent from the answer log. The log rejects repeats, so copied answers fail. Each key needs a fresh preimage; at target 2^24 that costs ~16M hash trials plus one logged slot. Task ids come from the ledger head, not a sonnet. A willow tag names the batch. The vertex field binds the answer to the chain tip.
